measurement_scope: complete public calls including intake; native phase includes request building, sealed session evaluation and advice projection
native_ordering: baseline,lazy on even model indices and lazy,baseline on odd model indices
ordering: baseline,lazy on even rounds and lazy,baseline on odd rounds; identical model order
sample_exclusion: none; every sample and failure is retained
semantic_acceptance: all complete witnesses, ties, search counters and request/plan bytes equal frozen baseline; independent exhaustive first-action minima match before and after current-call commitment; original native responses equal
workload_scope: declared finite model corpus, not an unseen natural application or the four-arm full-cost native workload
